name: carousel-3d
title: Carousel 3D
blurb: Three.js 3D spherical carousel with drag-to-rotate interaction.
description: CSS3DRenderer-powered 3D carousel that arranges items on a sphere with auto-rotation. Supports drag interaction to manually rotate. Loads Three.js dynamically for SSR compatibility.
use_when: Immersive product showcases or portfolio galleries requiring true 3D interaction.
avoid_when: Low-spec devices or browsers without WebGL; requires a sized parent container.
a11y: No keyboard interaction. Drag-only control makes it inaccessible without mouse input.
